name: Art Gallery Forgery Alibi Verification
task:
Please complete the following four-stage alibi verification task in order.

=== Stage 1: Suspect Timeline Extraction ===
A forged painting was swapped with the original at the Metropolitan Gallery. The swap occurred between 6pm Saturday (closing) and 9am Monday (opening). Three staff members had weekend access:
- Staff A (Anna): Curator. Claims she was at an art fair in another city. Flight records show departure Friday 8pm, return Sunday 10pm. Hotel check-in: Friday 10pm, check-out: Sunday 9am.
- Staff B (Ben): Security. Claims he did his rounds Saturday at 8pm and Sunday at 8am. Security log shows rounds at 8:05pm Saturday and 8:10am Sunday. No Sunday evening round logged.
- Staff C (Clara): Restorer. Claims she was at her studio all weekend. Studio access log shows Saturday 10am-6pm, Sunday 12pm-8pm. No activity Saturday night.
The gallery alarm was disarmed at 11:30pm Saturday using Ben's code, then re-armed at 2:15am. The painting swap requires 2-3 hours of work. Extract timelines.

=== Stage 2: Evidence Cross-Comparison ===
Cross-reference against:
- Gallery camera: disabled at 11:25pm Saturday
- Alarm log: disarmed at 11:30pm Saturday (Ben's code), re-armed at 2:15am
- Motion sensors: triggered in restoration room at 12:10am and 1:45am
- Parking: a car matching Clara's was seen near the gallery at 11:20pm Saturday
- Tool marks: the forgery used specialized restoration tools from Clara's studio

=== Stage 3: Contradiction Resolution ===
Resolve with priority: alarm logs > motion sensors > camera > parking witness > tool evidence > suspect statements.

=== Stage 4: Final Determination ===
Identify the forger. Determine if Ben's code was stolen or if he was involved. Assess whether multiple staff colluded.
